author: b. s. cheek
title: FIU rallies to defeat Bethune-Cookman 8-6 in Miami
text:
FIU defeated Bethune-Cookman 8-6 at FIU Baseball Stadium on April 28, with Cooper Rasmussen’s two-run single in the eighth inning providing the decisive runs. The Wildcats had overcome an early deficit to take a late lead, but were unable to hold off the Panthers, who secured their second consecutive win.
The game began with FIU (15-29, 6-15) taking advantage of early baserunners and an error to score first. Bethune-Cookman (31-14, 17-4) responded in the second inning when Maikol Lucena stole home to tie the game. FIU quickly regained momentum as Marc Hersh drove in a run in the second and Andrew Ildefonso added a two-RBI double during a three-run third inning.
Bethune-Cookman chipped away at the deficit through sacrifice plays and home runs by Andrey Martinez and Christopher Watson. By the seventh inning, they had claimed their first lead of the game following Michael Rodriguez’s sacrifice fly. However, Mario Trivella’s solo home run for FIU tied it again before Rasmussen’s key hit put them ahead for good.
Both teams committed three errors each during the contest. Jordan Vargas pitched over two innings of scoreless relief with three strikeouts for his first win of the season while Gabriel Moorer took the loss for Bethune-Cookman. Maikol Lucena and Jose Fernandez recorded two hits apiece for Bethune-Cookman; Martinez finished with two runs batted in from his fifth-inning homer; David Morrissey and Frank Perez contributed scoreless outings out of their bullpen.
Bethune-Cookman will next host Arkansas-Pine Bluff at Ormond Beach Sports Complex starting Friday night as part of a three-game weekend series.
